sections.habitat: Lakes and medium to large rivers.
sections.diet: It eats fish, insects, shrimp, snails, seeds and fruit.
sections.behavior: Adults shoal; activity peaks at night.
sections.reproduction: It spawns in rainy seasons; eggs are laid on plants.
sections.ecology: It is potamodromous; spawning migrations are reported.

sources.title: Meristic characters and biology of Schilbe mystus in Côte d’Ivoire — IRD
